name: El Campillo (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of white, blue and white crossed by a thin red horizontal stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Campillo (a sun and a bird on blue and red).
history: The arms and flag of El Campillo were approved by the municipal council on 2 December 1998 and ratified by the Junta de Andalucía by decree 215/1999 of 19 October, published in the BOJA on 4 November 1999; the flag has three stripes parallel to the hoist of similar size, white, blue and white, charged with a red stripe of 1/11 perpendicular to them, with the local arms centred over all.
